findings: The complete exported surface, original import paths, type import and escapeXml reexport identity are retained.
Both failure functions allocate ordinary objects in result/errorCode/message order with exact codes, unavailable prose and unescaped caller runId template.
The explicitly string-typed steering constant retains the exact supplied array initializer and join expression, including both long strings and single newline.
Timestamp uses native finite gate and Date.toISOString with only constructor/ISO errors caught and native String fallback.
Duration uses finite positive milliseconds, strict unit thresholds, floor, exact remainders, two-digit minute/second padding and unpadded day hours.
Relative age checks missing/nonfinite inputs, uses duration of the subtraction, and preserves future/rollback zero flooring; instant computes age before timestamp.
Count uses native finite gate, sign rule, trunc(abs(value)), native String digits and retained grouping regex/replacement, including native exponent behavior.
Attribute collapses and trims only string values, converts other values with native String, preserves raw names and calls original escapeXml once without error interception.
The module has no workflow execution, provider/service/user/file/network I/O, clocks, locales, schema substitution or new maximum/magnitude rules.
